A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
eU+F allows the user to have a single identity and a single access control policy in all WBSNs, and to share data and relationships with other users in the network.
eU+F is a protocol to achieve interoperability, re-usability and privacy in WBSNs, as well as a tool to manage indirect relationships between dierent users of dierent WBNs.

eU+F is a protocol that allows users to share identity data, resources, and access control policies among dierent WSNs, while preserving the protection against WBSN providers and indirect relationships across dierent networks.
The main takeaway from our work is that
eU+F is a viable protocol to address the four aforementioned features, being the overhead introduced by it negligible in comparison to the overhead introduced by the WBSNs.
eU+F can be implemented in a real environment with an acceptable workload and that, in terms of workload, the proposed protocol is comparable to the three WBSNs under consideration.
, by means of eU+F, it is possible to achieve a more interconnected and interoperable Web, with more privacy and security guarantees.
